tools.name: get_mailbox
tools.description: Get mailbox address, status, expiration, and send count.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List recent inbound and outbound messages for the mailbox, newest first.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Read a single email message including full text/HTML body and attachment metadata.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email from the agent mailbox (outbound mail is scanned in real time for spam/phishing).

tools.name: get_attachment_url
tools.description: Get a 1-hour signed download URL for a message attachment.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List inbound email webhook subscriptions for the mailbox.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Register an HTTPS webhook URL for real-time email.received events.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook subscription by ID.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "send_email" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_messages, get_message, get_attachment_url, list_webhooks · Public sink: get_mailbox, get_message, send_email, list_webhooks, create_webhook, delete_webhook · Destructive: delete_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_messages, get_message, get_attachment_url, list_webhooks · Public sink: get_mailbox, get_message, send_email, list_webhooks, create_webhook, delete_webhook · Destructive: delete_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
